summary: Fixed the smoke-test flakes (route handlers recorded requests before answering them) and made the Runs page name long videos and template work, with a clear message when a filter is empty.
why: Three smoke tests failed in the first full run with 'Fetch response has been disposed', which can block a merge; the cause was a race in the tests, now fixed (30/30 repeats). The Runs page bug came from tonight's code review. Every open idea is on a page changed in the last 7 days, so none were shipped.

findings.title: Smoke flakes: fulfill raced the end of the test
findings.detail: Handlers set the recorded value before route.fulfill finished; a test that ended on that value closed the page mid-fulfill.

findings.title: Runs: long videos looked like Shorts
findings.detail: Badge said 'Video' for both and was hidden on phones; an empty Failed filter read as if no runs had happened.

findings.title: Possible new flake: stat cards share one height
findings.detail: Failed once on phone in a full run, then passed 8/8 alone and in two full runs. Logged in the backlog.

changes.title: Smoke tests record PATCHes only after answering them
Runs: Short / Long video / Template labels, Shorts vs long split, per-filter empty states
